svg.aria-label: How a source reaches the Microsoft 365 index. Six on-premises sources — two SQL Server views, a Cloudera CDP cluster holding HDFS, Hive and Atlas, plus Oracle, Teradata and MongoDB — are each read by their own console tool. Before any read, a guard refuses a source that enforces access per user; SQL Server alone has no such guard. All six tools run the shared PushCore engine against a crawl state database that holds the item inventory, the run lock and the principal cache, and push straight to the Copilot connectors API. Every item is granted one AD group per connector. Microsoft Search and Microsoft 365 Copilot read the resulting index, and a read-only dashboard, a health watchdog and an optional OTLP collector watch the runs.
